title: Commitment Bonus on Small Business Electricity Supply Renewal Loyalty Credits
content:
**Bonus.** On the renewal loyalty credit of a Small Business Electricity Supply agreement, the renewed term's length is the whole months from its start date to its end date plus one; a renewed term of 36 months or longer adds 40.00 dollars; one of 24 to 35 months adds 20.00 dollars; a shorter one adds nothing.

The start date and the end date of the renewed term are those recorded on the agreement. Whole months run by calendar month from the start date, a month counting only once its day of the month is reached.

| Renewed term's length | Commitment bonus |
|---|---|
| 36 months or longer | 40.00 USD |
| 24 to 35 months | 20.00 USD |
| shorter than 24 months | none |

**Worked lengths (hypothetical renewed terms)**

| Renewed term | Whole months, start to end | Length (plus one) | Bonus |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 January 2027 to 31 December 2029 | 35 | 36 | 40.00 USD |
| 1 January 2027 to 31 December 2028 | 23 | 24 | 20.00 USD |
| 1 January 2027 to 31 December 2027 | 11 | 12 | none |
